description: Which other projects' issues a project's sprints take — the list behind the board menu's «🤝 Sprints take issues from…». Answers 'guests' (each with key, name, who added it and when), 'hidden' (how many listed projects you cannot open — counted, never named), 'acceptedBy' (the projects whose sprints take THIS project's issues: the other way round, for its own board) and 'mayEdit' (whether you may change the list with set_sprint_guests). Taking issues is one-way: CORE taking MOBILE's does not make MOBILE take CORE's. Any member of the project may read it.

projectKey.description: The project whose sprints take the issues (the host), e.g. 'CORE'.
